title: 基于 HF Jobs 的异步 GRPO 与 LoRA 训练：用存储桶和代理替代 NCCL
summary: 本文介绍了一种在 Hugging Face Jobs 平台上实现异步 GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）强化学习训练的方法，并结合 LoRA 进行参数高效微调。其核心创新在于摒弃了传统分布式训练中依赖 NCCL 进行 GPU 间通信的方式，转而采用对象存储桶（bucket）作为模型权重和梯度的交换媒介，并通过一个代理（proxy）服务来协调异步更新。这种设计使得训练任务可以跨不同节点、甚至跨不同作业（Jobs）运行，无需高速互联网络，降低了多 GPU 训练对硬件拓扑的要求。文章详细描述了架构组成：训练端将 LoRA 适配器权重写入存储桶，推理端从桶中拉取最新权重生成样本，代理负责版本管理和同步控制。该方案适用于资源受限或异构环境下的强化学习微调，展示了在 Hugging Face 生态中实现异步分布式训练的一种可行路径。
summary_en: This article presents an approach to asynchronous GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization) reinforcement learning training on Hugging Face Jobs, combined with LoRA for parameter-efficient fine-tuning. The key innovation is replacing traditional NCCL-based GPU-to-GPU communication with an object storage bucket as the medium for exchanging model weights and gradients, coordinated by a proxy service for asynchronous updates. This design allows training tasks to run across different nodes or even separate jobs without requiring high-speed interconnects, lowering hardware topology requirements for multi-GPU training. The architecture consists of: the training side writes LoRA adapter weights to the bucket, the inference side pulls the latest weights to generate samples, and the proxy manages versioning and synchronization. The solution is suitable for reinforcement learning fine-tuning in resource-constrained or heterogeneous environments, demonstrating a feasible path for asynchronous distributed training within the Hugging Face ecosystem.
